extrapolation_declaration.statement: every value this law returns above 95 C is EXTRAPOLATED; the reported 95 per cent band is a prediction band that already carries the leverage of that distance, and no value is presented as measured there

form_selection.rule: the lowest residual standard deviation in ln D* on the SOYBEAN set, which is the parameter set every Faner march of this record uses; the rule is fixed before the numbers are seen and the losing forms are reported beside the winner

loading_extrapolation_declaration.consequence: the loading-dependent law can be carried into the 2008 window only by extrapolating its loading regressor 6.4 to 12.8 times beyond the largest loading it was measured at, which is a larger extrapolation than the temperature one; both marched cases below are labelled with it, and a DECLARED HOLD case that never evaluates the law above the measured maximum is marched beside them so the reader can see what the measured envelope alone supports
loading_extrapolation_declaration.declared_hold_rule: above X = 0.015616 kg/kg the loading regressor is held at that measured maximum; below it the law applies as fitted. This is a declared refusal to evaluate outside the measured envelope, stated wherever its numbers appear, not a clamp applied to a solver refusal
loading_extrapolation_declaration.headline: Cardarelli's measured coefficients do not overlap the loading range of Faner's falling-rate window at all
loading_extrapolation_declaration.why_it_is_narrow: every tabulated coefficient is measured at a vapour activity of 0.10 to 0.81 over a sorption isotherm, so the particle holds only its sorbed inventory; Faner's falling-rate window starts at the critical loading, where the pore still holds condensed n-hexane

regressor_collinearity.what_it_means: the equilibrium loading at a fixed activity itself falls steeply with temperature, so the two regressors are strongly correlated across these 34 points; the activation energy and the loading exponent are correspondingly correlated, and the near-zero activation energy of the carried form must be read as INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM ZERO once the loading is carried explicitly, not as a measurement that the pore transport is athermal

retardation_is_independent_of_D.claim: the ratio is invariant to D to this spread, so D* = r * D_tab is an algebraic identity of the two forms and not a fit

refused_elements.element: the wet-core / cut-cell march above X_c for every curve of both sources
refused_elements.refusal: the constant-rate leg is posed here from a single-sphere energy balance on the bed's own transfer area, not from the certified moving-front march; at the P1EF production coefficients that march does not take an ordinary macrostep (validation record section 6), so the free-liquid regime is still not marched

refused_elements.element: an INDEPENDENTLY measured film coefficient for the plotted runs
refused_elements.refusal: the coefficients marched in stage 1 are now the source's own printed h from its hexane-vapour heat-transfer experiments, on the same 0.011 m2 footprint, and are no longer borrowed from a packed-bed correlation for a different geometry. But Equation 4.9 INFERS h from the same run's evaporation rate, so it is not an independent film measurement; it is the rig's own drying rate re-expressed as a coefficient. The identity of any tabulated experiment with any plotted run is UNESTABLISHED (source_reading.md), and circularity_probe reports how close the source's own arithmetic comes to the digitized slope of each plotted curve instead of hiding the exposure. Neither source prints a gas velocity or flow rate for the plotted runs, so the coefficient cannot be transported to them by velocity either

refused_elements.element: the frozen Coletto film pair as the stage-1 authority
refused_elements.refusal: retained and marched as the REFERENCE case over its declared 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.0 interval so that every 2026-09-21 number is reproduced in these CSVs, but it is no longer the number quoted: it is an isolated-particle packed-bed correlation for a geometry the experiment does not have, and the source measured the coefficient itself

refused_elements.element: a gas velocity, flow rate or Reynolds number for the plotted runs of Figure 4.21 and Figure 2
refused_elements.refusal: p. 103 states that all hexane-vapour runs used the apparatus's maximum evaporation capacity, so the source could not evaluate the influence of vapour velocity, and the twelve printed velocities span only 0.113 to 0.131 m/s. Velocity is therefore recorded in the selection and is NOT used to choose between experiments (rule R6); the match is made on material and gas temperature alone

refused_elements.element: the mass convention of the printed W_harina in Equation 4.8
refused_elements.refusal: p. 98 defines W_harina as the mass of the meal sample, p. 95 and Figure 4.21 give X in kg hexane per kg DRY meal, and p. 99 abbreviates the denominator to 'kg de harina'; the excerpt does not settle whether the tabulated mass is the dry or the total sample mass. Step A's transfer area reads it as the total mass, unchanged from 2026-09-21, and circularity_probe reports the implied loading slope on BOTH conventions rather than choosing one silently

refused_elements.element: the mutual consistency of PHY-050 critical volume and PHY-020 GAB storage at the crossing
refused_elements.refusal: the critical loading X_c puts the particle on the GAB branch at a hexane activity above one, which is outside the isotherm's measured activity domain although inside the solver's own admissibility ceiling; the two frozen laws do not meet at a_h = 1 and the gap is reported, not closed

refused_elements.element: the diffusivity law of step B evaluated inside the falling-rate window of either source
refused_elements.refusal: Cardarelli's 34 tabulated coefficients are measured at equilibrium loadings of 7.7e-4 to 1.56e-2 kg/kg, while Faner's falling-rate window runs from 0.199 down to 0.10 (2008) and 0.0074 (2019) kg/kg; the two ranges do not overlap at all above 1.56e-2, so the law's loading regressor is extrapolated 6.4 to 12.8 times there. The case law_log_loading carries that extrapolation and says so; the case law_log_loading_held refuses to evaluate the law outside the measured envelope

refused_elements.element: a space-resolved loading-dependent diffusivity D(X(r)) inside the certified flux divergence
refused_elements.refusal: the certified dry shell is posed with one scalar D_eff per step, so the loading dependence measured in step B cannot be carried inside its divergence; it is evaluated once per stride, at the volume mean and at the surface, and those two conventions are reported as a BRACKET rather than one being presented as the answer. The bracket is wide because D varies by about a decade across the particle, and no loading-dependent number of this record is quoted without it
